findings.evidence: NEW ROUND-2 FINDING: 309-01-step-sauce.network.json contains 3 boot-time 401s on critical kiosk endpoints — POST /api/frontend/kiosk-event @ ts=1778440399428, GET /api/frontend/menu @ ts=1778440399446, POST /api/frontend/pricing/preview @ ts=1778440404556. Same 401s also surface as console errors (`Failed to load resource: the server responded with a status of 401 (Unauthorized)`) in the matching console.json. The cluster-1 commit 95c2fd799 explicitly excluded 401 from the new axios toast interceptor (`Excludes 401 (handled by surface-specific router redirects)`); kiosk-toast-container exists in DOM but stays empty (innerText empty across 7 toast container divs). UX impact is negligible — wizard renders correctly, all items load, recap totals match (12.50€ etc.) — because the kiosk SPA acquires its Sanctum token shortly after these failed boot calls and the menu/pricing requests are retried successfully. However: per REVIEWER_PROTOCOL.md category 10 the 401 is NOT in the allowlist (allowlist only covers 401 on /api/auth/logout). Treating as P3 audit hygiene rather than P0 silent_error because (a) functional outcome correct, (b) totals integrity preserved, (c) no customer-visible breakage observed.
findings.fix_hint: Two angles: (1) Boot ordering: defer the initial /api/frontend/kiosk-event + /api/frontend/menu + /api/frontend/pricing/preview calls until after the kiosk Sanctum token is bound (await token before first dispatch in resources/js/store/modules/kioskMenu.js — investigate kioskMenu.fetchMenu() and any mounted() hook in KioskAppComponent.vue). (2) Allowlist update: add `'/api/frontend/kiosk-event','/api/frontend/menu','/api/frontend/pricing/preview' boot 401` to the protocol allowlist if the boot-401 is by-design and the eventual retry succeeds. Either path closes this finding; (1) is cleaner.
